description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-TYPE: For the Currency groups of FC (g1 [922337203685477.5807, 0.0001, -0.0001]; g2 [922337203685477.5807, 1, -1]; g3 [-1, 1, 922337203685477.5807]; g4 [1, 922337203685477.5807, -1]; g5 [922337203685477.5807, 922337203685477.5807]; g6 [-922337203685477.5808, -1, 1]; g7 [0.0001, 0.0002, 0.0003]; g8 [922337203685477.5807, -922337203685477.5808, 1]; g9 [0.0001, 0.0002]; g10 [100000000.0001, 100000000.0003]; g11 [-922337203685477.5808, -922337203685477.5808]; g12 [0.0001, 922337203685477.5807]), what does Sum return, with which Field type, size and precision properties, or raise, and at which call (open, first row), one statement per group (WHERE g = 1 to 12); and what do SELECT Sum(c) over the whole table, and GROUP BY g with Sum, give when some groups overflow? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
